sources.name: MAME C64 conformance reference
sources.license: BSD-3-Clause selected CPU and C64/VIC source; upstream COPYING retained
sources.use: Test-only behavioral reference for C64 memory and NMOS 6510 bus execution. No system ROMs or MAME binary; excluded from FPGA and ARM firmware builds. Exact subset and hashes in third_party/mame_reference/import_manifest.json. Dual-SID adapter and MOS8726 REU methods provide test-only expansion references; 16MB address capacity is an explicit extension beyond the MAME 512KB model.
